description: This file contains a PHP class 'Migration' responsible for performing a database migration related to the 'time' module in the OrangeHRM system. It extends an abstract migration class and implements methods to update default page priorities for user roles and modules during version 4.1.2 upgrade.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A class that performs specific database updates for the 'V4_1_2' migration, particularly updating default page priorities for the 'time' module for the 'Admin' user role.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Executes the migration steps to set the priority of 'time/defineTimesheetPeriod' for the 'Admin' role within the 'time' module.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string of this migration, which is '4.1.2'.
